If this position is not of interest or not suitable at this time, we will sincerely appreciate if you could share the job with your friends or colleagues. 
Thank you for your time


 Job Title: Portal Developer

Location: Chicago, IL

Duration: Long term


Experience designing Enterprise services and message model schemas and creating UML diagrams for design phase deliverables 
· Expert knowledge of SOA, Object-Oriented design and programming concepts, design patterns 
· Expert knowledge and development experience with Java, J2EE, JSP, JDBC, JAXB, servlets, RAD6/ RAD7, DAOs, JUnit, SQL, HTML, XML, JAX-WS, WSDL 
· Demonstrated experience with Spring MVC, Hibernate, CXF, SOAP, ANT and ANT scripting, UNIX/ LINUX, Wiley 
· Development and troubleshooting experience on the Web Sphere Application Server platform 
· Knowledge and experience with performance tuning, preferably with enterprise web services 
· Knowledge and experience with HCSC Membership/ Blue star systems highly preferred 
· Knowledge and experience developing portlets using Spring Portlet MVC framework, WebSphere Portal 6.1 and JSR 168 standard is nice to have 
· Solid understanding of relational databases and DB2 Excellent verbal and written communication skills 

- Requires in-depth knowledge and experience- Uses best practices and knowledge of internal or external business issues to improve products or services
- Independently solves complex problems; takes a new perspective using existing solutions- Works independently, receives minimal guidance
- Acts as a resource for colleagues with less experience; may direct the work of other staff members Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Systems or other related field. 

Or equivalent work experience.

3 -5 years of programming/systems analysis experience. WebSphere portal (6.1 and above) install and environment maintenance WebSphere portal performance tuning Development experience (1-3 yrs) in JSR 168, JSR 286, EJB 3.0, Spring, Hibernate, web services, WebSphere portal code deployment and skin and theme setup WebSphere portal database integration with application server WebSphere portal configuration and xml script creation and maintenance.
